purpose: An affidavit in Form No. NCLT-6 is submitted along with an application under section 230 of the Act for an order of a meeting.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Submit an application in Form no. NCLT-1.
Include a notice of admission in Form No. NCLT-2.
Include an affidavit in Form No. NCLT-6.
Include a copy of the scheme of compromise or arrangement with required disclosures.
Pay the prescribed fee as per the Schedule of Fees.
Disclose to the Tribunal the basis on which each class of members or creditors has been identified.
checklist: Notice of admission in Form No. NCLT-2
Copy of scheme of compromise or arrangement with section 230(2) disclosures
Fee as prescribed in the Schedule of Fees
attachments: Notice of admission in Form No. NCLT-2
Copy of scheme of compromise or arrangement
watch: Serve a copy of the notice of admission and affidavit on the company or liquidator not less than fourteen days before the hearing if the company is not the applicant.
